```yaml
name: Regression Tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ['3.8', '3.9', '3.10', '3.11']
        test-group: ['fast', 'network', 'slow', 'core']

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt

    - name: Run tests
      run: pytest -m "not regression" tests/${{ matrix.test-group }}/

    - name: Upload test results
      uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
      with:
        name: "Python ${matrix.python-version} ${matrix.test-group}"
        path: "**/htmlcov/**"
        reporter: "python-cov"

  regression-build-and-test:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python 3.10
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.10'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt

    - name: Run regression tests
      run: pytest -m regression tests/

    - name: Upload test results
      uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
      with:
        name: "Python 3.10 Regression"
        path: "**/htmlcov/**"
        reporter: "python-cov"
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file defines two jobs:

1. `build-and-test`: This job runs on multiple Python versions (3.8, 3.9, 3.10, 3.11) and test groups (fast, network, slow, core). It checks out the code, sets up the specified Python version, installs dependencies, runs tests excluding regression tests, and uploads the test results using the `dorny/test-reporter` action.

2. `regression-build-and-test`: This job depends on the `build-and-test` job and runs only on Python 3.10. It checks out the code, sets up Python 3.10, installs dependencies, runs regression tests, and uploads the test results using the same `dorny/test-reporter` action.

The workflow is triggered on pushes and pull requests to the `main` branch. The `build-and-test` job runs in parallel for each combination of Python version and test group, while the `regression-build-and-test` job runs separately for regression testing.
